summary: Vail Mountain Rescue Group (5 members) assisted Eagle County Sheriff's deputies in recovering human remains found in the wilderness west of Eagle Ranch; the body was that of an Eagle man reported missing in November 2011 who had died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound; all rescuers were out of the field by 7 p.m.
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Eagle County Sheriff's Office
notes: Vail Daily feed (Edward Stoner) via Vail Chamber Nov/Dec 2014 mission roundup; incident recorded at remains-recovery date; subject unnamed in source
